nodes.description: TASK-472.09. The finder refuses a vault whose link leads out of that layout as VAULT_NOT_FOUND (reason vault-outside-layout), before the command registers anything. The server uses isVaultLayout and checkoutOfVault to serve only vaults in that layout.

nodes.description: TASK-472.09. No environment variable names a vault any longer: a set ARCHBOARD_VAULT is refused before the command runs, and the finder's origin is -C or working-directory. isVaultLayout says whether a path is the .archboard/vault of a directory, and checkoutOfVault gives the directory that holds it. The finder refuses a vault whose link leads out of that layout as VAULT_NOT_FOUND (reason vault-outside-layout), before the command registers anything. The server uses isVaultLayout and checkoutOfVault to serve only vaults in that layout. TASK-480: in a checkout with no vault, the finder asks the lookup it is given for the known vaults whose boards bind the checkout's repository, and the refusal names each one as the -C to give, with its boards.

nodes.description: TASK-480. The known vaults are the ones the navigator lists: the vault of each chosen checkout and each untracked vault that exist, in the .archboard/vault layout. A board counts when a node of any variant binds the repository. Each file is decoded in memory, so no lease is taken and no migration is written in another repository's vault.
